patterns.note: The primary content area features a dynamic, overlapping collage of images and large text elements, breaking from traditional grid-based layouts.

As the user scrolls down, the initially dense collage of images and text elements animates outwards, dispersing across the screen to reveal more white space and individual elements. The navigation bar remains sticky at the top.
A very large, italicized serif font ('And And And Studio') serves as a central, expressive visual element, contrasting with smaller, functional sans-serif navigation links.
A minimalist background of white and black text provides a clean canvas, allowing the rich, warm, and earthy tones within the photographic content to stand out.

technique_notes: To rebuild the main content area, position images and text elements using absolute or relative positioning to create an initial overlapping collage. Implement scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations (as detected) for these elements, defining their translation and rotation values to cause them to spread out and reveal more of the canvas as the user scrolls down. The navigation bar should be fixed to the top of the viewport with a solid background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, expressive serif display text (~3-4x body) creates a strong visual anchor, complemented by smaller, functional sans-serif navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most image containers, contributing to a clean, architectural feel, despite the organic collage layout.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and dynamic due to the scattered, overlapping elements that disperse further on scroll, creating a sense of expansive white space.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic, non-grid collage layout where images and text elements are initially densely overlapped and then animate outwards with a scroll-triggered dispersion effect. This creates a highly interactive and artistic presentation that breaks from conventional linear page structures.
